## Research prototype checklist

- [ ] Changes use synthetic data only; no patient identifiers or records
- [ ] No diagnosis, prescribing or automated regimen selection introduced
- [ ] Python unit tests pass
- [ ] Frontend production build passes (if changed)
- [ ] Evidence citations and source metadata reviewed (if changed)
- [ ] Security/privacy and limitations documented
- [ ] Base branch and stacked PR dependencies confirmed

This checklist does not establish clinical validity or regulatory compliance.
